Highlights from our brands

School shop

Stay prepared with high-quality and long-lasting school uniforms in our back-to-school collection, including school shirts, pinafore dresses and PE kits .

Kit them out with durable school shoes and school bags to carry them through the school day.

Spooky season

The spookiest day of the year is on the way. Get ready for pumpkin season with our Halloween range. Find Halloween costumes for all the family and spooky Halloween decorations to turn your home into a haunted house.

Cosy at home

Stay cosy indoors with our range of heaters and electric blankets . We also have lots of soft and comfy home furnishings to get your home ready for autumn, including thermal curtains and rugs . Or choose a duvet cover set in a cute autumnal print for chilly nights.

Home refresh

Make cleaning a breeze with vacuum cleaners and carpet cleaners . Ideal for tackling stubborn stains, help your carpets feel fresh and new. Or for hard floors, steam cleaners offer a cleaning solution that leave surfaces sparkling.

If you’re having a declutter, we have lots of home storage solutions to help keep your space neat and tidy. Looking to kit out your kitchen? We have a wide range of appliances including the ever-popular air fryers to make mealtimes easier.

If you’re looking to get guest-ready, look at our sofas , including our new made-to-order sofa range. Pick a style, size, and colour to fit perfectly into your living room.

Play time

When you need entertaining, explore our exciting toys. Discover popular brands like LEGO® and Barbie .

We also offer toys for the youngest members of the family. Our toy offers provide lots of ways to save on toys, helping you stock up for special occasions.

Get gaming

Experience the power and iconic design of the PS5 , complete with the PS5 DualSense controller for an action-packed, dynamic experience.

Enjoy next-generation gaming with the Xbox Series consoles , which support a wide variety of immersive games.

For a more portable gaming experience, check out the Nintendo Switch 2 . Enjoy multiplayer fun with games like Animal Crossing, Breath of the Wild and Mario Kart, all at your fingertips.

Dive into gaming adventures in comfort with our ergonomic gaming chairs . With adjustable features to fit your setup, these chairs are ideal for long gaming sessions.

Check out the latest upcoming games to see what’s coming to your favourite console. Stay ahead of the curve and be ready for the next big release.
